resolutions.rationale: Medium is warranted because at 4575520–4637880 ms Joe explicitly lacks the quotation, is unsure that Lombard is its author, and alternates between signification of God, substance, and creation. The surrounding exchange establishes the intended terminological challenge but cannot settle the recalled text or its scope. His later audio-confirmed qualification separates the uncertain creator objection from the knowledge concern. Speaker attribution is clear; the material uncertainty concerns reconstructing the textual warrant, not merely whether his conclusion is persuasive.

High is warranted for assessment of this deliberately limited move: at 5620000–5685560 ms Joe explicitly contrasts the Word becoming flesh with flesh becoming related to the Word and expressly allows that this may be coherent but counterintuitive. The preceding handoff asks for his own conditional objection, which he mildly endorses; the later audio-confirmed theological-face-value reply confirms that his concern is theological description rather than a wholesale denial of ordinary extrinsic predication. Mild confidence in the objection itself does not make its content or assessable scope unclear.

Both options withhold an additional adjustment, but option-b more specifically matches the locked positive burdens and decisive source bridges. Christopher grounds conceptual distinctions in one divine essence at 787960–887560 ms, concedes a route around the shared-nature argument while retaining explanatory costs at 3548680–3607880 ms, distinguishes intrinsic intellect from extrinsic contrastive knowledge at 5074760–5193760 ms, and offers union and Christological-predication defenses. Their successes and remaining gaps belong to those moves; no independent completion consequence is established that would justify counting them again.

Option-b states the critical burden more accurately than the generic completion criterion in option-a. Joe declines to assert Platonism at 294440–332200 ms and confines the nature-level primitive alternative to what the particular identity argument excludes at 2869720–2952800 ms. He presses a knowledge-specific concern rather than confidently adopting the creator objection, and the audio-confirmed final theological reply expressly calls its presumption defeasible and nondevastating. These conditional challenges and their limited supporting bridges are move-level consequences, not a separate obligation to prove polytheism or disprove classical theism, so an additional adjustment would duplicate them.
